headline: Samajwadi Party Confirms Congress Seat Demand For Uttar Pradesh Polls
seoTitle: Congress Seeks 181 Seats In UP Election
metaDescription: Akhilesh Yadav confirmed the Congress party has requested 181 seats to contest in the upcoming Uttar Pradesh legislative assembly elections.
aiSummaryBullets: Congress has requested to contest 181 seats in the upcoming Uttar Pradesh elections.
Samajwadi Party President Akhilesh Yadav confirmed the formal demand during a leadership summit.
The Samajwadi Party maintains that candidate winnability remains the priority for alliance planning.
aiContextParagraph: The political landscape in Uttar Pradesh is seeing early maneuvering ahead of the 2027 legislative assembly elections. Congress has formally requested to contest 181 seats, a figure disclosed by Samajwadi Party President Akhilesh Yadav during his appearance at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit. This development follows a period of electoral collaboration between the two parties, most notably during the 2024 Lok Sabha elections where they aligned to oppose the Bharatiya Janata Party. While seat-sharing discussions are ongoing, the Samajwadi Party leadership has emphasized that electoral strategy will prioritize the winnability of potential candidates over the specific number of seats allocated to coalition partners. The current discussions reflect the parties' ongoing efforts to consolidate their position against political rivals in the state as they prepare for the next round of voting.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained attention due to reports from multiple national outlets documenting high-level coalition negotiations between major political parties in India.
